name: EPIC 212303202
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 7.1 solar radii and 1.00 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212303202 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.054128 (16th-84th percentiles 6.81192-7.310756), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212303202: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4753.8223 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212303202 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2375.078125 (16th-84th percentiles 2305.878906-2446.542969), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.21 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,375 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.00 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,754 K at its surface.
